Frequently asked

ZimPro-Linkup is free to use — post jobs, browse services and chat for free. Payments and deliveries are arranged directly between you and the other person, outside the app.

ZimPro-Linkup is Zimbabwe's marketplace for home help, jobs and services — connecting people who need trusted help with skilled Zimbabweans ready to work, from housemaids and gardeners to electricians, tutors, designers and more.

Post a job, browse services near you, chat, and get things done — all for free. Version 1.0.0
